blocking.section: dialect 0.2.13 ss13.4 accuracy envelope (pin adopted by this change set in SPEC_VERSIONS.toml and dist manifest 'dialect: 0.2.13'); softfloat/trans.h tn/trans_core via tsc, softfloat/ppc_round.h ppc_round

steps.claim: The adopted contract requires every finite own-format transcendental result within one local ulp of the exact result over the full finite domain, using ordered canonical-pair values for ppcf128, and the correctly rounded (directed-neighbour) outcome for constrained modes; the dist manifest itself states the contract as '0.2.13 13.4: full-domain one-local-ulp; constrained correctly rounded selection and exact flags'. (The packet's attached 0.2.10 text waives correct rounding; this change set re-pins to 0.2.13, so 0.2.13 is the governing text.)

The implementation evaluates PPC transcendentals at TRANS_BITS=240 significant working bits: softfloat/trans.h tn() jams every finite value to 240 bits, and trans_domain explicitly notes 'PPC sparse residuals require their own full-precision treatment' but provides none outside the exp near-zero path, so a sparse pair near 2^-700 gets only ~240-bit relative accuracy while its local pair ulp is 2^-1074 absolute.
steps.by: witness:softfloat/trans.h tn() and trans_domain in the frozen snapshot at 015b424

steps.claim: Hand derivation: for x = pair(2^-700), sin(x) = x - x^3/6 + ... = 2^-700 - 2^-2102.58..., bracketed by canonical pairs (2^-700, -2^-1074) below and (2^-700, +0) above at distance 2^-2102.58 from the upper. So nearest/upward/nearest-away must return (2^-700,+0) and downward/towardzero (2^-700,-2^-1074), flags exactly inexact (16). The published LLVM18 bitcode returns (2^-700, -2^-940) (hi bits 0x1430000000000000, lo bits 0x8530000000000000) in all five modes: below the exact result for upward mode and 2^134 local ulps from it, i.e. outside the one-local-ulp envelope.
steps.by: witness:private bridge built from dist/llvm18/bennett-arith.bc (generate.py + clang-18 in tmp-muse) calling __bennett_sf_sin_ppcf128_rm(0x1430000000000000, rm) for rm 0..4; equivalently BENNETT_ARITH_PROMISED=1 python3 -B -I tests/test_directed.py 18 --quick, documented failing in docs/quality.md

steps.claim: Therefore the published ppcf128 transcendental carriers diverge from the change set's own adopted ss13.4 contract on a concrete well-formed input, in the council's stated focus area (soft-float rounding); disclosure via conformance_pending and the PROMISED opt-in does not make the returned bits conform.
